ground_and_maritime.headline: 國防部偵獲共機14架次與共艦9艘 6架次逾越海峽中線
ground_and_maritime.summary: 國防部表示，自8月5日上午6時至8月6日上午6時止，共偵獲14架次共機、9艘共艦及7艘公務船在台海周邊活動。其中有6架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾中部、西南及東部空域。國軍運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控並妥善應處。
ground_and_maritime.headline_en: Taiwan Detects 14 PLA Aircraft and 9 Naval Vessels Around Island
ground_and_maritime.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting 14 Chinese military aircraft, nine naval vessels, and seven official ships operating around the island between 06:00 on August 5 and 06:00 on August 6, 2026. According to official figures, six of the aircraft sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's central, southwestern, and eastern airspace. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat air patrols, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the military activity around the Taiwan Strait.

ground_and_maritime.headline: 漢光演習國軍搭客輪馳援綠島蘭嶼驗證防衛能量
ground_and_maritime.summary: 國軍「漢光42號演習」於2026年8月6日進入第2天，逾百名官兵在台東富岡漁港搭乘客輪，運送建制武器與物資馳援綠島及蘭嶼。第二作戰區表示，本次演練採實兵實物驗證離島應援能量，官兵登島後即構築防禦工事並操作無人機進行戰術偵查。
ground_and_maritime.headline_en: Han Kuang Exercise: Troops Board Ferries to Reinforce Green Island and Orchid Island
ground_and_maritime.summary_en: On August 6, 2026, during the second day of the Han Kuang 42 exercise, over 100 military personnel gathered at Fugang Fishery Harbor in Taitung to board passenger ferries with weapons and supplies, embarking for Green Island and Orchid Island. Taiwan's Second Operational Zone stated that the cross-sea exercise verified offshore island reinforcement capabilities using live personnel and equipment, with troops deploying to tactical positions to construct defense fortifications and perform tactical drone reconnaissance.
